plain: Something that causes great suffering to many people

webster.text: A whip; a lash consisting of a strap or cord; an instrument of punishment or discipline.

more.text: He or that which greatly afflicts, harasses or destroys; particularly, any continued evil or calamity.
To afflict greatly; to harass, torment or injure.

example.quote: Thus, we should, in a little time, see established in every part of this country the same engines of despotism which have been the scourge of the Old World.
